svg.title: Toolbox
svg.desc: Hardware description: SystemVerilog, Verilog, VHDL, UVM, SystemC, SPICE; Design and verification: RTL design, Logic synthesis, Timing analysis, Formal verification, Testbench development, Gate-level simulation, Lint, Physical design, 45nm and 28nm CMOS; EDA: Synopsys DC, PrimeTime, VCS, Verdi, Spyglass, JasperGold, Virtuoso, Vivado, Quartus, ModelSim; Open-source flow: Verilator, Yosys, cocotb, Tree-sitter, Neovim; Languages: Python, Rust, C, Lua, Tcl, Bash, TypeScript, SQL, R, MATLAB; Domains: CPU microarchitecture, Error correction coding, Cryptographic hardware, Finite-field arithmetic, FPGA design, ASIC design, Low-power design, SoC architecture, DSP, Reconfigurable computing.
svg.text: 50 languages, tools and domains in 6 groups
